    echo Fiber::suspend('Y'), '|';
    return 17;
});
$other = new Fiber(static function () { echo 'X|'; return 99; });
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
echo $target->start(), '|';
$receiver = $target;
$method = 'ReSuMe';
$pair = [&$receiver, &$method];
$resume = $pair(...);
$again = $pair(...);
$copy = clone $resume;
$returnPair = [$target, 'getReturn'];
$get = $returnPair(...);
echo (int)($resume == $again), (int)($resume == $copy), (int)($resume === $copy), '|';
$receiver = $other;
$method = 'throw';
$pair = null;
$returnPair = null;
$receiver = null;
unset($target);
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
$resume(value: 7);

<?php
function arrayFccFreshBody19() {
    global $original;
    Fiber::suspend('Y');
    $original = new Exception('body');
    throw $original;
}
$target = new Fiber('arrayFccFreshBody19');
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
echo $target->start(), '|';
$receiver = $target;
$method = 'ReSuMe';
$pair = [&$receiver, &$method];
$resume = $pair(...);
$direct = $target->resume(...);
echo (int)($resume == $direct), '|';
$receiver = new Fiber(static function () { return 99; });
$method = 'throw';
$pair = null;
unset($target, $direct);
try { $resume->__invoke(value: 'R'); }
catch (Exception $caught) {
    echo (int)($caught === $original), '|', $caught->getMessage(), '|';
    foreach ($caught->getTrace() as $frame) {
        echo $frame['function'], '.', (int)isset($frame['file']), (int)isset($frame['line']), '|';
    }
}
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
unset($resume);
echo (int)($weak->get() === null);
engine_derived_expectation: Array FCC freezes dereferenced receiver and method, compares like the same direct FCC, retains the selected receiver through retired aliases, and preserves fresh body Exception identity and real saved explicit-invoke trace.
